protocol: Parhelion v2 staged multi-source transfer evaluation
stage: frozen before full T4 validation collection

algorithm.name: Parhelion
algorithm.description: Retrieval-anchored Bayesian Thompson tuning over existing joint features plus four source-only retrieval features
algorithm.budget_1: query the highest consensus retrieval action
algorithm.later_budgets: Thompson sampling with frozen retrieval features and observed bank-0 target feedback

source_archive_exclusions_per_fold: all workloads from the held-out model family
every source workload with the exact target (M,N,K) shape
leakage_controls.cross_workload_feedback: One posterior is shared across the 24 target workloads in a held-out-family fold. Budget b is b target configuration measurements per workload; the fold uses 24*b target measurements and all four folds use 96*b. The protocol does not claim independent-workload tuning or b total target measurements.

multisource_retrieval.grid: independent 12-point Cartesian product of k and temperature

selection_order: select multi-source retrieval k and temperature over its independent 12-point grid
select pooled-source transfer strength over its independent 4-point grid
freeze both baseline winners, then select Parhelion over its 48-point grid
freeze the strongest eligible comparator after all method parameters are fixed
t4_validation.selection_metric: Mean fraction of held-out bank-1 reference, with equal weight for every held-out-family fold, seed, and budget
t4_validation.primary_comparator_rule: After all Parhelion and baseline hyperparameters are independently frozen, freeze the highest validation AUC; break exact ties by ascending method name
t4_validation.budget_one_invariant: Parhelion and independently tuned multi-source retrieval query and recommend the identical frozen retrieval anchor at budget 1; both methods are charged for that query.

h100_final.freeze_rule: Before the only H100 invocation, write and hash an immutable artifact containing every selected hyperparameter, the primary comparator, exact source archive, all protocol fields, and SHA-256 digests of the implementation files. Do not rerun, expand any grid, or change the method after observing H100.
h100_final.primary_endpoint: Paired per-seed Parhelion minus T4-frozen-comparator mean AUC over budgets 1 through 8 after equal model-family-fold averaging
h100_final.uncertainty: Two-sided 95% Student-t confidence interval over 30 paired seed deltas (29 degrees of freedom)
h100_final.claim_threshold: Use superiority wording only when the primary confidence-interval lower bound is greater than zero; otherwise report no demonstrated superiority.
h100_final.failure_rule: Fail closed if any expected H100 measurement cell is missing, unusable, incorrect, duplicated, or non-finite. Publish no H100 performance claim and do not rerun the H100 collection.
h100_final.reporting: Use the T4-frozen comparator for the primary paired claim. Any H100-selected strongest baseline is descriptive only.

source_cost.disclosure: Validation uses a two-GPU source archive; final evaluation adds T4 as a third source. This changes source collection cost, not the algorithm or frozen hyperparameters.

claims.novelty: Describe Parhelion as a new retrieval-anchored combination; do not claim to be first without a systematic literature review.
claims.stability: Do not claim stability from 12 validation seeds or 30 replay seeds.
claims.scope: Claims are limited to the measured FP16 Triton matmul corpus, four named GPU instances, fixed candidate set, and staged protocol.
